slices.focus: Caleb and Lena attend a neighborhood pet blessing with Roux, providing a much-needed social reset and introducing neighbor Nadine Carver as a friendly drainage-information contact
slices.summary: During a rough stretch, Lena pushes Caleb to attend a low-key neighborhood pet blessing with their dog Roux. The outing provides a rare social reset, and Caleb meets retired neighbor Nadine Carver who becomes a friendly source of neighborhood drainage observations during evening walks.
